My Free Code is a Python gateway that routes Claude Code and other AI agents across multiple LLM providers. It exposes standard Anthropic /v1/messages and OpenAI /v1/responses endpoints with tier-based routing. It includes launcher adapters for tools like Cline, Codex, and Hermes while managing rate limits and fallbacks.
